text:
Which precaution does not always reduce a scientist’s exposure when working with sources of
ionising radiation?
A
ensuring the scientist only works with sources of radiation that have long half-lives
B
increasing the distance between the scientist and the source of radiation
C
limiting the time for which the scientist handles the source of radiation
D
placing a lead shield between the scientist and the source of radiation

options.label: A
options.text: ensuring the scientist only works with sources of radiation that have long half-lives

options.label: B
options.text: increasing the distance between the scientist and the source of radiation

options.label: C
options.text: limiting the time for which the scientist handles the source of radiation

options.label: D
options.text: placing a lead shield between the scientist and the source of radiation
